title: Morse-Novikov theory for links
summary: For a compact 3-manifold W. Thurston introduced a norm on the first cohomology group of the manifold. The unit ball $B$ of this norm is a polyhedron and the set of cohomology classes that are representable by fibrations over a circle is a union of cones on some of the open faces of $B$. In the present paper we study the fibred faces of the Thurston polyhedra of exteriors of links in $S^3$. Our approach is based on the non-abelian Novikov homology associated with the universal covering of the exterior of the link.
